record.title: Type actor occurrence and storage acceptance time
record.intent: Distinguish validated new occurrence timestamps, preserved legacy time strings and authoritative storage acceptance time.
requirements: Introduce validated nominal timestamp types and a distinct legacy representation; preserve every historical nonblank recorded_at string and its original receipt/revision digest.
New assertion envelopes validate occurrence timestamps through a versioned decoding boundary. An actor cannot assert an authoritative accepted-at value.
Storage acceptance time is separately typed and supplied only by the accepting boundary; domain evaluation has no ambient clock and uses revisions rather than actor time for ordering and CAS.
acceptance: Malformed, ambiguous and spoofed timestamp inputs are rejected for new envelopes, while old arbitrary nonblank strings reconstruct unchanged as historical values.
Receipt, reconciliation and import review round trips preserve their original protocol identities; JVM/native corpus and process parity pass.
